name: MessageComposer
summary: Input surface for composing a message.

a11y.apg: No APG pattern: it is a <form> with a text input and a submit button, and native semantics deliver the behaviour — Enter submits because the form does, not because we listened for a key. The input always has an aria-label, since a placeholder disappears the moment you type and so cannot be a name.

props.name: onSend
props.type: (text: string, details?: {files: File[]; replyToId?: string; editingId?: string}) => void
props.description: Called with the trimmed text, then the field clears itself. Empty or whitespace-only never sends, and the send button stays disabled until there is something to send. The second argument exists only when attach, replyTo or editing is in use, so a call checked as onSend(text) still is exactly that.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint inside the field. It is not the name — a placeholder disappears the moment you type.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the input, which is what a screen reader reads.

props.name: icon
props.description: Carbon glyph inside the field, before the text.

props.name: sendLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the send button, which shows only an icon.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field and the button together.

props.name: attach
props.type: boolean | {accept?: string; maxSize?: number; multiple?: boolean}
props.description: A paperclip inside the field opens the file picker. The chosen files sit above the field, inside the same frame, with FileInput's row (.file-item: name, size, a thumbnail for images, remove) and FileInput's filter and messages. Uploading is the app's: the files go out in onSend. With a file, an empty text can be sent. Hidden while editing.

props.name: replyTo
props.type: {id: string; author?: ReactNode; body: ReactNode} | null
props.description: The message being answered, shown above the field as a quote (who, and its first line). The field takes focus. The id goes out in onSend as replyToId.

props.name: onCancelReply
props.description: The X on the quote, and Escape in the field. The app clears replyTo.

props.name: editing
props.description: Edit mode: the old text fills the field, Send becomes Save, and the id goes out in onSend as editingId. When editing ends, the field is cleared — the old text does not stay as a draft.

props.name: onCancelEdit
props.description: The X on the quote, and Escape in the field. The app clears editing.
